title: Dedicated capacity: SLA stacking and commitment pathways
creator: Anika Rao
description: Define a modular set of commitment pathways and stacked SLA tiers for Dedicated capacity that let enterprise customers combine reserved GPU commitments, burst credits, and autoscale headroom while preserving clear latency/availability guarantees. Deliverables: pricing curve proposals, contract language snippets for SLO guarantees and overage handling, an SQ-ready appendix, and an internal playbook for sales/solutions engineering to position options.
goals: Create 3 commitment pathways: Base Reserve, Reserve+Burst, and Reserve+Autoscale
Define SLA stacking semantics (primary SLA + fallthrough tiers + soft-crediting)
Produce a pricing matrix that maps GPU-hour equivalent to p99 latency targets and burst credit allocation
Ship a one-page SQ appendix mapping common legal/security asks to product controls and telemetry
Pilot pricing on 6 enterprise accounts and collect conversion metrics
acceptance_criteria: Pricing matrix reviewed and signed off by Finance
Legal-approved contract language for SLA credits and preemption paths included
Sales playbook and two sample commercial proposals created
SQ appendix passes Security review and is attached to enterprise proposals
Pilot cohort of minimum 6 customers committed to trial pricing and instrumentation enabled
decisions: Adopt three-tier commitment model instead of continuous sliding bands to simplify procurement
Burst credits will be amortized across the commitment period and visible as 'burst bucket' in billing
Autoscale headroom sold as a percentage multiplier (10/25/50%) of reserved capacity with defined ramp windows
Primary SLA will be p99 latency floor; fallback SLA will be availability and degraded-latency bands with crediting logic
blockers: Final kernel-level throughput benchmarks for large context models (ENG-19123)
Decision on how to surface burst bucket usage in Console billing UI (ENG-20544)
Legal negotiation template for multi-region failover language
next_steps: Triage benchmark gaps with Infra and SRE; target completion 2025-02-20
Build pricing simulators (Finance + PM) and run three demand scenarios
Draft SQ appendix and submit to Security for review by 2025-02-24
Prepare sales playbook draft and two sample commercial proposals for pilot customers
